items.example: He decided to drop out of university after eight months there.
My mind was made up, so the next day I went to the admin office.
They tried to cover up their disappointment and support my decision.
At that very moment, a neighbour popped round to ask about uni.
Everyone thought I was mad, but I stuck to my guns.
Think it over, but do not overthink it before you decide.
Trust your instincts when you make a life-changing decision.

items.phrase: a weight lifted off your shoulders
items.example: If you feel a weight lifted off your shoulders, it is the right decision.
Let those doubts come, and then do not hold onto them.
Appeal to their logic and their emotions when you explain.
Do not expect people to get on board with your decision immediately.
Give them time to process it and come to terms with it.
Listen to their concerns and address them with patience.
I saw a job advert for a farm hand, so I decided to give it a try.
If you have doubts about a decision, let the thoughts pass.
Think it over, sleep on it, but do not overthink it.
Then plan your next step and look for support elsewhere.
